articles.author: Hanna Ziady
articles.title: France’s student protests highlight a debt crisis that could spill over to the rest of Europe - CNN
articles.description: France’s unprecedented wave of student protests has laid bare the country’s growing financial pressures, which will only become more difficult to tackle as Europe’s second-largest economy tries to rein in a ballooning budget deficit.
